en: Everyone in town has shut themselves indoors. Even I'd rather not set foot outside just now.
They say Wallace is the strongest trainer in all of Hoenn. And this town's Gym is led by the man who taught him!
But the Elite Four are said to be stronger still. How strong can they be?
Aren't Pokémon our friends? Why are they raging like this?
Whatever happens, wherever I am, I'll always be friends with Pokémon. Being with them is the best fun there is!
A move that puts everything into one blow... Double-Edge. Shall I teach it to one of your Pokémon?
Double-Edge hurts the one who uses it too. Save it for when it matters most.
Another time, then. I'll be here.
An Egg can't learn anything until it hatches.
I'm afraid that one can't learn it.
That move can't be forgotten here. Another time, perhaps.
